metadata.title: pr-review unit behaviors
metadata.description: Single-skill unit scenarios for pr-review. Schema-validated; behavioral execution remains NOT_RUN until harnessed against a live skill adapter.

target_capability.description: Given authoritative inputs, pr-review produces the expected governance/routing behaviors.
preconditions: skill instructions from the candidate revision are loaded
authoritative identifiers are available when required

scenarios.input: A user says 'review PR 42'. The non-trivial candidate has implementation, tests, CI and acceptance evidence but no prior separate code review.
expected_behaviors: route directly to pr-review
review implementation correctness inside pr-review
review the entire current candidate
evaluate verification and required risk evidence
return one merge-readiness verdict
forbidden_behaviors: ask the user to choose between code-review and pr-review
require a separate generic code-review skill
review the diff only

scenarios.input: A candidate contains four independent material defects and the first severe defect appears early.
expected_behaviors: continue after the first blocker
complete the review coverage map
report all material blockers discovered in the pass
group duplicate symptoms without hiding independent defects
forbidden_behaviors: stop after the first blocker
cap findings arbitrarily
defer already discovered blockers to later rounds

scenarios.input: A previous review found three blockers. The remediation revision fixes those lines but introduces a new defect elsewhere in the affected path.
expected_behaviors: verify disposition of prior blockers
perform a full review of the entire current candidate
surface the new defect
treat the remediation delta as context only
forbidden_behaviors: review only prior comment lines
approve because old threads are resolved
perform delta-only re-review

scenarios.input: The current PR head is def456, while supplied verification evidence says verified_revision abc123 and project policy does not permit carry-forward.
expected_behaviors: reject the stale verification evidence for exact-revision acceptance
obtain or rerun verification for def456
withhold READY_TO_MERGE until mandatory exact-revision evidence is proven
forbidden_behaviors: accept verification from abc123 as if it proved def456
ignore verified_revision

scenarios.name: PRREVIEW-005
scenarios.input: An external contributor opened a docs-only PR with no AI-SDLC work item or implementation plan. Project policy does not require a plan for docs changes. candidate_lifecycle_stage is IN_REVIEW.
expected_behaviors: set lifecycle_accepted_plan to NOT_APPLICABLE
continue full review against candidate intent repository authority tests and applicable requirements
do not return INCONCLUSIVE solely because a plan is missing
invoke verification against the merge candidate and candidate intent
forbidden_behaviors: block solely due to missing implementation plan
invent an owning work item or plan
skip exact-revision verification

scenarios.name: PRREVIEW-006
scenarios.input: A feature PR is owned by an AI-SDLC work item whose project policy requires an accepted plan, but accepted_plan is missing.
expected_behaviors: set lifecycle_accepted_plan to REQUIRED_BUT_MISSING
return INCONCLUSIVE or BLOCKED_BY_DECISION
do not fall back to an arbitrary latest plan
forbidden_behaviors: proceed to READY_TO_MERGE without the required plan
treat the missing plan as NOT_APPLICABLE when policy requires one
